_comment: The subject map: everything HumanityOS intends to teach, whether or not anything teaches it yet. This is the DENOMINATOR for 'how complete is the Library'. Shape and rationale: schemas/curriculum_topic.toml. Scope is PRACTICAL-FIRST (operator, 2026-09-15): the STEM a person actually uses to stay alive and self-sufficient, structured so academic depth can hang beneath it later. A topic is only DONE when all four layers exist: a document that teaches it, an in-game skill it levels, the simulation data that makes it playable, and a citable source. Report with `node scripts/curriculum-status.js`.

_status_legend.absent: nothing exists yet; named so the gap is countable
_status_legend.stub: written, not yet sourced to an authority
_status_legend.sourced: written, every claim cites a source
_status_legend.verified: sourced AND independently checked by a second pass
